entries.title: Psalms 70:1
segments: ¶<<To the chief Musician. [A Psalm] of David: to bring to remembrance.>> Make haste, O God, to deliver me; Jehovah, [hasten] to my help.

entries.title: Psalms 70:2
segments: Let them be ashamed and brought to confusion that seek after my soul; let them be turned backward and confounded that take pleasure in mine adversity;

entries.title: Psalms 70:3
segments: Let them turn back because of their shame that say, Aha! Aha!

entries.title: Psalms 70:4
segments: Let all those that seek thee be glad and rejoice in thee, and let such as love thy salvation say continually, Let God be magnified!

entries.title: Psalms 70:5
segments: But I am afflicted and needy: make haste unto me, O God. Thou art my help and my deliverer: O Jehovah, make no delay.
